description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Attach Dark 3 with Stacking], [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000], [Physical Blink Stacking 2], [Shadowhound Mode] and [40% Damage Reduction Barrier 1] to the user

description.name: Carnage Cutter
description.text: 1/4/8 single ranged/single/single attacks (0.80 each) if the user Physical Blink 0/1/2, grants [Physical Blink 1]/[Physical Blink 1] if the user has Physical Blink 0/1, 100% hit rate at Physical Blink 0

description.name: Murderous Urge
description.text: Three single attacks (0.80 each), grants [Ninja +30% Boost 3] to the user

description.name: Attach Dark 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Dark Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Dark 3

description.name: Physical Blink Stacking 2
description.text: Allows to stack Physical Blink, up to Physical Blink 2

description.name: Shadowhound Mode
description.text: Casts Midnight Passage when any Damage Reduction Barrier is removed, removed after triggering five times

description.name: 40% Damage Reduction Barrier 1
description.text: Reduces damage taken by 40% for the next attack

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands
